riskFactors.title: Office Sector Concentration
riskFactors.description: 100% office portfolio with 6 buildings concentrated in KL commercial precincts creates sector and regional exposure.

mitigatingFactors.factor: 6 properties across 3 sub-markets (Golden Triangle, Damansara, Bangsar South)
Diversified tenant base across professional services, GLCs, MNCs
Quality Grade A and GBI-certified assets

aggravatingFactors.factor: KL office market challenging with oversupply concerns

riskFactors.title: Extreme Floating-Rate Debt Exposure
riskFactors.description: 100% floating-rate debt exposes UOA REIT to full OPR volatility. Each +25bps impacts DPU by ~0.26 sen (~3.7%).

quantitativeBacking.context: Highest rate sensitivity in peer group

aggravatingFactors.factor: No interest rate hedging instruments disclosed
OPR increases flow directly through to finance costs
Major shift from 59% fixed in FY2024 to 0% in FY2025

riskFactors.title: Australian Parent Oversight
riskFactors.description: Cross-border ownership structure with United Overseas Australia Ltd (ASX-listed) provides additional governance layer.

mitigatingFactors.factor: Professional management team with long tenure

riskFactors.title: Standard Disclosure Practices
riskFactors.description: Regular disclosure of financial metrics with standard Bursa Malaysia compliance.

riskFactors.title: Short WALE Risk
riskFactors.description: 1.36-year WALE is notably short, creating near-term re-leasing pressure in challenging office market.

mitigatingFactors.factor: +19% occupancy improvement at Menara UOA Bangsar shows recovery
Quality tenant base (Skrine, Bank Rakyat) provides stability
19% Menara UOA Bangsar gain demonstrates leasing success

aggravatingFactors.factor: KL office market oversupply pressures rents
Aggressive retention pricing may compress margins

riskFactors.title: Aligned Sponsor Structure
riskFactors.description: 45-50% ownership by United Overseas Australia Ltd creates alignment, though listed parent diversifies sponsor risk.

mitigatingFactors.factor: Major sponsor stake aligns interests with unitholders

observations.title: Encouraging Recovery Signs
observations.content: FY2025 shows positive momentum with +13.2% DPU growth to 6.95 sen and +19% occupancy gain at Menara UOA Bangsar, marking potential trough exit.
observations.summary: +13.2% DPU growth, occupancy recovery, RM77.5M NPI

observations.title: Critical Rate Sensitivity
observations.content: 100% floating-rate debt makes UOA REIT most rate-sensitive in peer group. Shift from 59% fixed (FY2024) to 0% fixed (FY2025) amplifies OPR risk significantly.

observations.title: Short WALE Challenge
observations.content: 1.36-year WALE creates constant re-leasing pressure. While +19% Menara UOA Bangsar improvement is positive, short leases require ongoing tenant retention efforts.
observations.summary: 1.36-year WALE, 19% occupancy gain at key property

observations.title: Deep Value Opportunity
observations.content: Trading at ~44% discount to NAV (RM0.80 vs RM1.42) with 8.7% yield offers deep value for contrarian investors, if recovery trajectory continues.
observations.summary: 44% discount to NAV, 8.7% yield, value opportunity
